story_review.one_viewing_summary: A driverless car can be hailed to the San Antonio airport. The service began in February in a 60 square mile area. In April one empty car was swept down a creek and another stood stranded in floodwater. A federal software recall covering 3,791 vehicles says the car may slow and then drive into standing water. The remedy is under development. An interim weather-limit update reached every car by April 20. The ride is open while the remedy is unfinished.
story_review.opening_to_ending: The film opens on a car arriving at the airport curb and closes at the same kind of bay with the door open, set beside the remedy row stamped Under development. The opening question about what the record says is answered by the stamped row, without claiming any repair or rider outcome.
